summary: Style blocker overruled: the code confirms the documented sign convention is correct.

disagreements.accuracy_position: No issues raised; documentation approved as accurate.
disagreements.style_position: Claimed the @return sign description is backwards: that `a compare b` returns negative when `a` is later than `b`, not earlier.
disagreements.rationale: The implementation `a compare b` delegates to `Deadline.compare`, which computes `a.time - b.time`; since `Deadline` wraps a `FiniteDuration` measured from now, an earlier deadline has a smaller duration value, so `a` earlier than `b` yields `a.time < b.time` and thus a negative result — exactly what the @return states.
